description: This file contains functions for generating and managing XML test summary reports in a testing framework, including functions for opening, closing, and writing different parts of a test report in XML format.

methods.name: int clar_summary_close_tag(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * tag,int indent)
methods.description: Outputs an XML closing tag with proper indentation based on the provided indent level.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testsuite(struct clar_summary * summary,int idn,const char * name,time_t timestamp,int test_count,int fail_count,int error_count)
methods.description: Outputs an XML <testsuite> element with metadata including id, name, timestamp, and test counts.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testcase(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * name,const char * classname,double elapsed)
methods.description: Outputs an XML <testcase> element with a name, classname, and elapsed time.

methods.name: int clar_summary_failure(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * type,const char * message,const char * desc)
methods.description: Outputs an XML <failure> element with type, message, and description inside a CDATA section.

methods.name: int clar_summary_skipped(struct clar_summary * summary)
methods.description: Outputs an XML <skipped /> element indicating a skipped test.

methods.name: struct:clar_summary * clar_summary_init(const char * filename)
methods.description: Initializes a new summary report, opens a file for writing, and returns a struct representing the summary.

methods.name: int clar_summary_shutdown(struct clar_summary * summary)
methods.description: Finalizes the report by closing XML tags, writing errors, and closing the file, freeing resources.

ctags.signature: (struct clar_summary * summary,const char * type,const char * message,const char * desc)

ctags.signature: (struct clar_summary * summary,const char * name,const char * classname,double elapsed)
